images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of OpenTumorBoard. Each LLM simulates a virtual multidisciplinary tumor board that reviews patient cases spanning 11 clinical modalities, engages in back-and-forth discussion, and reaches consensus on cancer care.

header: 2OpenTumorBoard: A Real-World Benchmark of Multidisciplinary Cancer Discussions from YouTube

images.caption: Figure 2:Automated construction of OpenTumorBoard. The pipeline transcribes and diarizes each tumor board recording, segments the discussion into patient cases, and extracts slides from video frames. It then infers the clinical role of each speaker, temporally aligns utterances with the displayed evidence, and removes information leakage to construct multimodal inputs forSpecialistTurnandBoardSimulation.
Figure 3:A, the discussion trajectory of a representative case across 10 specialist roles.B, Distribution of OpenTumorBoard by cancer site, modality, specialist role and specialist turn type.

Figure 4:SpecialistTurnperformance by 9 specialist turn types. The heatmap reports mean clinical equivalence to real specialist responses across 4,844 test questions. The left panel reports average response length, with error bars indicating standard deviation.
